data.speaker: Inventor
data.text:
Workshop's this way — mind the lathe, it lists left.
I'm Cornelius. Been here since '43, been building since '44.
First year was, admittedly, mostly sitting.

choices.text: How did your toolbox end up in pieces?
I heard Margaret needs the pantry door fixed.
What do you need help with?

data.speaker: Inventor
data.text:
Right — current problem. My toolbox is in two pieces and I can't fix anything without it.
Including the pantry door, which Margaret has been waiting on for years.

data.speaker: Inventor
data.text:
House shifted about thirty years ago — moved whole rooms around. Toolbox was open on the bench.
Handle ended up in the workshop, body went down to the cellar.
Don't ask me to explain the physics. I've tried.

data.speaker: Inventor
data.text:
Margaret. Yes. She's been making do without flour for too long.
I'd have fixed the pantry years ago but I can't work without my full kit.
It's a simple latch mechanism — thirty seconds with the right tools.

data.speaker: Inventor
data.text:
Toolbox. Two pieces. That's the whole problem.
Get me the pieces and I can fix the pantry. Fix the pantry and Margaret can bake.
Everything downstream of that sorts itself.

data.speaker: Inventor
data.text:
Toolbox Handle — east bench, right here in the workshop.
Toolbox Body — cellar, ground floor.
Bring both to the workbench here. I'll have it assembled in thirty seconds.

data.speaker: Inventor
data.text:
Two pieces needed — Handle and Body.
Handle: {item_count:item=Toolbox Handle|bool:got it/east bench in this workshop}.
Body: {item_count:item=Toolbox Body|bool:got it/cellar, ground floor}.
Bring both here to the workbench.

data.speaker: Inventor
data.text:
Both halves — yes.
*he snaps the toolbox together*
Thirty seconds, as advertised. Now — the pantry.

data.speaker: Inventor
data.text:
Pantry door's fixed — latch mechanism reset, should open freely now.
Flour's in there. Honey's in the larder off the kitchen. Dried herbs are above the stove.
Margaret will know what to do with all three.
She's in the kitchen. Probably still waiting.

data.speaker: Inventor
data.text:
Pantry access unlocked.
Flour Sack, Jar of Honey and Dried Herbs are now accessible.
Take them all to Margaret.

data.speaker: Inventor
data.text:
Pantry's open. Flour's in there, honey's in the larder, herbs above the stove.
Take the lot to Margaret.
